name: R2-BRIDGE-01 mechanically auditable causality / memory-correctness / determinism contract

allowed.definition: The policy's own resident map, per-object score, per-object last_ref, and global access ordinal at the moment of the current access() call.

Exactly the AgedFrequency-identical state B_selected(M) itself would have accumulated up to and including the current access -- no additional history beyond what the frozen baseline already causally sees.

The DecayedTransitionPredictor's own internal state for the layer being served, built only from that layer's own same-layer history up to and including the most recently observed event of that layer -- identical causal boundary to experiments/R2-10-working-set-predictor/causal_boundary.json.

A retention/eviction decision made while serving event (step, layer) may use only information available strictly before or at that event; the predicted-next set consulted during that decision was computed from the PRIOR same-layer event, never the current or a future one.

forbidden.definition: Any request/event at a step occurring after the step currently being served, in any layer, must never influence an eviction decision made for the current step.
Any same-layer event at iterator position > the current one for that layer.
Any R2-10 EVAL content or not-yet-opened BRIDGE holdout content; Phase 0 opens neither.

causality.mechanical_audit_requirement: argine.research2.r2_bridge01.retention_policies._BaseBridgePolicy._refresh_prediction_after_observing is the SOLE path by which a layer's predicted-next set is updated, and it is called only AFTER that layer's current event has been fully served -- so the predicted set consulted during access() for event j+1 was computed strictly from events 0..j. tests/test_r2_bridge01_leakage.py enforces this empirically: altering a synthetic trace's events strictly after a chosen decision boundary, while holding the visible prefix identical, must leave every retention decision up to and including that boundary (admission, eviction victim, resident set) bit-identical.

invariants.definition: resident_bytes must never exceed the configured budget at any point during or after any access() call.
invariants.enforcement: argine.research2.r2_09a.fast_replay.run_fast already raises InvariantViolation on violation; R2-BRIDGE-01 policies are driven through the same run_fast path unmodified.

invariants.definition: Every resident (layer, expert) object's accounted byte size must equal Context.bytes_of(layer) exactly, for every mechanism.
Every eviction must decrement resident_bytes by exactly the evicted object's accounted size and increment self.evictions by exactly 1.

The PredictedProtectPolicy hard-shield fallback (falling back to the unrestricted choice when every resident object of a layer is protected) must be total and deterministic -- it must never leave an access() call unable to make room, which would otherwise silently violate the budget invariant.
stable_obj_key(layer, expert_id) ascending is the final tie-break for every mechanism, identical to AgedFrequency's own, so no two runs can disagree on a tied victim.

A config whose bonus is outside PredictorRetentionScorePolicy.FROZEN_BONUS_GRID, or a budget outside B_SELECTED_PARAMS_BY_BUDGET, must raise ValueError at construction time rather than silently substituting a default.

determinism.requirement: Repeated replay with identical trace, predictor, policy, budget, and config must produce bit-identical scientific results (miss_bytes, misses, evictions, peak_resident_bytes, per-layer breakdown).
determinism.mechanism: Every mechanism's internal state is a pure function of the sequence of access() calls it receives, with no randomness, wall-clock reads, hashing-order dependence, or external I/O; DecayedTransitionPredictor's own correctness is already independent of call order (see argine.research2.r2_10.predictors.DecayedTransitionPredictor._decayed_state docstring: 'correctness never depends on call order, only speed does').

control_equivalence.requirement: PredictorRetentionScorePolicy with bonus=0.0 must reproduce AgedFrequency / B_selected(M) bit-for-bit on any trace and budget -- a first-class correctness check on the wrapper itself, not merely a scientific result.
